He holds them tightly just letting the emotions wash over him.
“Hey, it’s alright. You’re safe. Your friends are safe.” They continue to hold him.
"I could have done more. Been faster, smarter, braver. I fucked it all up."

“We all have made mistakes. We all think we could have done better. But we didn’t. I once told you what a wise man once told me: we can’t change the past with tears. We can only change the future with our actions. It’s alright. It’s alright we’re gonna get past this, okay?”
